phase_1_inference_mechanism.q1_step1_input: Full sequence with target audio region 100% masked with audio_mask_id (1024) across 8 codebooks.
phase_1_inference_mechanism.q2_logits_and_confidence: Predicts [B, 8, T, 1025] logits, masks out mask_id log-prob to -inf, takes argmax for tokens and max(softmax) for confidence.
phase_1_inference_mechanism.q3_step1_unmask_selection: Scores = confidence - (layer_ids * 5.0) + gumbel_noise; unmasks top-k1 (50% of total masked positions) via torch.topk.
phase_1_inference_mechanism.q4_step2_token_state: x_student_1 containing 50% revealed discrete tokens (layers prioritized 0->7) and 50% mask_id.
phase_1_inference_mechanism.q5_step2_unmask_selection: Scores computed on full sequence; already revealed tokens masked to -inf; remaining 50% positions unmasked (k2 = rem).
phase_1_inference_mechanism.q6_schedule_and_ranking_role: Schedule defines quantity (k) per step; confidence + layer penalty defines priority order across acoustic hierarchy.
phase_1_inference_mechanism.q7_non_destructive_invariant: Verified true. Revealed tokens strictly preserved; scores.masked_fill_ sets prior tokens to -inf preventing overwriting.
